# GifCities

## The Geocities Animated Gif Search from Internet Archive

[![](/static/gifsearch/spinning-ia-logo.gif)](https://archive.org)

GifCities is a special project of [Internet Archive](https://archive.org), a non-profit digital library of millions of free books, movies, software, music, websites, and more. Please consider [donating](https://archive.org/donate) to help us in our efforts to provide “Universal Access to All Knowledge” including GIFs.
